info.title: IceFlow API — Nhà máy đá tinh khiết Rubi
info.description: Generated from src/lib/contracts. Describes the API as it behaves today. Most endpoints wrap their payload in `{ success: true, data }`; the exceptions are noted per endpoint.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description:
Access: Public.

Sets the httpOnly `auth_token` cookie (7 days) and also returns the JWT in `token` for non-browser clients. Rate limited to 5 attempts per IP per minute. The counter is keyed by the `x-real-ip` header and shared with `/api/auth/refresh`: without a proxy that sets `x-real-ip`, every client falls into one shared bucket.

post.description:
Access: Any signed-in user.

Used by the mobile app. Rate limited to 30 per IP per minute, on the same counter as `/api/auth/login`, so refreshes also use up login attempts.
